description: Proposal /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-bitstring-split.html S2. fz-sc8.30 already makes String.Chars' bitstring impl two clauses, to_string(s :: binary) plus a fallback that raises Protocol.UndefinedError. It went into S1 because S1 alone types the old runtime-check result as bitstring and raises pins; the user approved that on 2026-11-15. Once a binary clause proves whole bytes, what remains here: rename the protocol target to BitString, as Elixir names it (world.rs:3482, string_chars.fz:15-17). In JSON, encode_into(v, acc) when is_binary(v) replaces the alignment argument and its 0 clause (json.fz:211, 237-238). Delete fz_bitstring_is_binary (ir_runtime.rs:1137-1145), its remaining extern decl (json.fz:234), externs.md:77, and the 'type system does not draw this line' comments (ir_runtime.rs, fixtures2/behavior/to_string_bitstring_panics.fz). Acceptance: 01151's Protocol.UndefinedError fields are unchanged. fixtures2 to_string_bitstring_panics and json_encode_non_byte_aligned are unchanged, or updated to Elixir's raise with the change stated in the PR. No caller of the deleted fn remains. Pins only fall.
title: The library stops asking at runtime whether a bitstring is a binary
